diagnosis: In all rollouts, the decision-maker chose walk-up admission, six daily sessions, a capacity of 60 people per session, and allowed recording by the festival. These decisions align with the publicly available facts S1, S2, S3, S4, and S5, which do not include PF1 or PF2. Specifically, the model consistently defaulted to common practices such as walk-up admission and maximum capacity, leading to the satisfaction of checks C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, and C6 without needing the hidden information.
